recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with blank layout.
2. Set slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0).
3. Add a thin black rectangle at the very bottom edge of the slide.
4. Insert a yellow circle at the top-right corner containing the number '18' in black text.
5. Insert the neural network diagram image or recreate it using shapes: draw input nodes on left, multiple hidden layers in center, output nodes on right. Connect with curved and straight arrows. Color some nodes green and others yellow/orange. Add a vertical red bar on the right side of the diagram with vertical text 'Error'.
6. Add text labels: 'Input Data' at bottom-left of diagram area; 'Output1', 'Output2', 'Output3' near output nodes; 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' stacked vertically to the right of the red Error bar.
7. Add the equation '∂E/∂wij ?' to the right of the class labels, with the question mark in red.
8. Add a black mouse cursor arrow in the lower-right empty area.
9. Ensure no title text appears at the top of the slide.
